checks.name: Four separate creation modes and 246 bundled assets
Twelve shape choices, live preview, guidance endpoints 1 and 100
Quarter checklist excludes unchecked programs and includes every checked type
Building whitelist is enforced inside the exact concave city envelope
Distinct quarter rooftops render, and the new asset category is browsable
Changing one quarter program and undo preserve exact previous geometry
Local region is distinct from campaign mode, defaults to 20 km and no villages or roads
Local controls drive physical extent, mean/relief in metres, optional roads and cave count
Local elevation/land-cover, hillshade and kilometre hex-grid styles are independent
Local ruler uses 1 km for a tenth of a 10 km survey; cursor shows metre elevations
Elevation CSV downloads all 25,600 metre-based samples with the requested mean
Grid metadata export states the local map physical extent
Pointy-top movement grid works independently of a rectangular outer boundary
Stamp snapping lands at the rendered pointy-hex center, not square vertices
Flat-top play-area boundary clips the map and rejects stamps outside it
Hex SVG, PNG and grid metadata exports preserve the selected orientation
Universal VTT contains a real PNG and explicit Megamap hex-grid metadata
Cold-theme palette preserves pointy-hex grid and a nonempty clipped cave
All 15 quarter types remain present even when target blocks is set to 12
No quarters produces editable blank plots rather than silently adding unwanted buildings
Saved atlas round trip preserves new envelopes, programs, DEMs and hex settings exactly
The shipped v1 starter atlas opens without regenerating its original geometry
No unhandled JavaScript errors in all v1.2 browser workflows

limitations: Not a native Windows BAT execution test.
Inline harness does not test file navigation, CSP enforcement or persistent browser storage recovery after restart.
